snippet.title: Super Agent - Launch Trailer (Playdate)
snippet.description:
Super Agent is an epic 3D platformer featuring special levels, such as piloting a helicopter or snowboarding.

All the footage was captured on Simulator capped to 30 FPS to match the final game performance.

00:00 Intro
00:30 Gameplay
00:45 Helicopter
00:48 Snowboarding
00:55 Shooting
01:03 Interface
01:11 Time Trial
01:44 Outro

Developed by Risolvi Productions.
Soundtrack by Rupert Cole.
Cover Art by Rae.
